comps.label: C2

comps.label: C3

comps.label: C4

comps.label: C5

comps.label: C6

comps.label: C7

comps.label: C8

comps.label: C9

comps.label: C10

comps.label: C11
comps.reason: Title insurance underwriter with escrow, closing and real estate data businesses, serving property transactions rather than brokerage.

comps.label: C12
comps.reason: Retail and wholesale insurance brokerage, program administration and personal lines, earning carrier commissions and consulting fees, matching Brown & Brown.

comps.label: C13
comps.reason: Property and casualty insurer that writes policies and underwrites risk, not an intermediary placing coverage for clients.

comps.label: C14
comps.reason: Independent retail insurance agency placing personal, commercial and benefits coverage for commissions, closely matching Brown & Brown's business.

comps.label: C15

comps.label: C16
comps.reason: Specialty insurer and reinsurer that underwrites and bears risk, unlike Brown & Brown's broker model.
